pageSummary: 胸部已补回两侧红色供血弧，血管与浅蓝支气管的遮挡层次比 v2、v3 清楚；膀胱内部紫红弧已移除，橙色面恢复干净。膀胱左上蓝短管还露着圆切头，需要收进肠袢前景。两块仍是美术候选，固定端口、主图像素注册和实际通路尚未通过。

resolvedSinceV3.finding: Two red access arcs now join the mauve lung-loop tops; the v3 wholesale deletion of the visible supply arcs is repaired in appearance.

Near each hilum, the red access now disappears behind the lighter matte-blue bronchial foreground. The darker glossy blood loops remain distinguishable from the flat lighter blue airway tree; this is easier to read than the v2 exposed red bridges and v3 purple-only airway contact.

chest.redBlueFalseJunctionReview: No new obvious red-to-dark-blue systemic T-junction is visible in this v4 comparison. A red/blue projected contact at a lung hilum is now covered by foreground, rather than visibly welded to the deep blue trunk. This visual observation does not certify shared-node topology or exact hidden interval boundaries.
chest.overDeletionReview: The two major missing lung supply arcs are restored. Coronary/functional central blood paths and all smaller registered visible intervals still cannot be individually certified from the beauty crop.
remainingLimits: Exact lengths/endpoints of the restored red arcs have not been registered against the fixed guide; a model-created short extension could still fall into a frozen hidden span.
Macro lungs/heart/shoulders are recognizable, but exact silhouettes and untouched crop-boundary pixels are not certified.
Blood-air separation is visually improved, not a complete exact-mask collision/separation PASS.
chest.requiredNextAction: Use this corrected material candidate in a controlled source-coordinate composition or port/hidden-mask comparison before declaring the chest route artwork final; do not add branches or erase the two required red access arcs again.

resolvedSinceV3.finding: The purple/red curves that crossed the orange bladder interior are gone. The interior and outlet are clean and recognizable; blood is shown only as short peripheral approaches. This answers the current painting objection without changing frozen gameplay geometry.

The upper-right red bladder approach now tucks behind the bowel/bladder foreground instead of appearing to start directly from the large surrounding blue venous ring. No obvious new red-to-blue welded T-junction is seen there.

remainingPaintIssue.finding: The upper end of the short glossy blue tube at the bladder upper-left is still an exposed rounded blue cap rather than a clear tissue-covered continuation. It reads as a little cut pipe in the open dark gap.
remainingPaintIssue.coordinateLimit: The candidate crop is mapped proportionally to [350,628,674,844] only for locating the paint defect. This is not exact registered endpoint evidence.
remainingPaintIssue.minimumRepair: Cover just the cap/reflection/shadow with the existing lower-left bowel foreground or its local soft shadow. Leave the rest of the short blue approach and bladder rim unchanged. Do not lengthen it to create a new blood junction or relocate the named exit.
doNotDo: Repaint the orange core as a battlefield
Change e143/e197/e198 source paths or flow

lowerAbdomen.rightRedApproachReview: The corresponding right red short approach is more naturally tucked under the bowel and bladder foreground in this image; no equally exposed cut cap is apparent there.
lowerAbdomen.frozenDeepGeometryNotice: e143/e197/e198 still have original paths inside the bladder outline; they were not rerouted. Hiding their beauty paint changes display only and does not establish a new wall-only cell movement domain.
remainingLimits: Direct-generated peripheral approaches are not proof that their junctions land on the two fixed named ports.
The unchanged broad original-style blue arcs remain incidental image pigment until their relationship to the final graph is explicitly registered.

deliveryVerdict.minorPaintFixOutstanding: Left upper bladder blue cap; local cover only.

limits: Only remaining-vessels-art-audit-v4.json written by this reviewer; prior audits, raw resources, final reference, production scripts and gameplay remain unchanged.
